name: aadt_near_point
description: US road traffic volume (AADT, annual average daily traffic) for road segments within a radius of a lat/lon, busiest first. Data: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System, per roadway section as reported by the state (not a counter reading). state is required. Returns route_id, functional class, AADT with single-unit and combination-truck splits, milepost range, data_year.

lon.description: Longitude, WGS84 decimal degrees (negative in the US).

state.description: Two-letter USPS state code (50 states, DC, PR), e.g. "CA". Required: route_id and county_id are state-specific.

year.description: HPMS data year (e.g. 2024). Default: newest year published for the state. Call aadt_layers to see which years exist.

name: aadt_by_route
description: US road traffic volume (AADT) for segments of a named route in one state, from FHWA HPMS. route is a case-insensitive PREFIX of the state's route_id (state-specific free text, e.g. "I089" in Vermont, "IH0035" in Texas, "SHS_101" in California); use aadt_top_segments to see a state's id style. A highway may carry several ids (e.g. IH0035-KG, IH0035-LG). Busiest segments first.

state.description: Two-letter USPS state code (50 states, DC, PR), e.g. "CA". Required: route_id and county_id are state-specific.

year.description: HPMS data year (e.g. 2024). Default: newest year published for the state. Call aadt_layers to see which years exist.

name: aadt_top_segments
description: The busiest road segments in a US state by AADT (annual average daily traffic), optionally within one county or functional class (1 Interstate ... 7 Local). From FHWA HPMS; per roadway section as reported by the state. Also the way to learn a state's route_id naming style.

state.description: Two-letter USPS state code (50 states, DC, PR), e.g. "CA". Required: route_id and county_id are state-specific.

f_system.description: Optional functional system 1-7: 1 Interstate, 2 other freeway, 3 other principal arterial, 4 minor arterial, 5 major collector, 6 minor collector, 7 local.

year.description: HPMS data year (e.g. 2024). Default: newest year published for the state. Call aadt_layers to see which years exist.

name: aadt_layers
description: Which FHWA HPMS data years exist for a US state and which columns each year carries (the newest years drop route number/name columns), so callers can pick a year before querying.

state.description: Two-letter USPS state code (50 states, DC, PR), e.g. "CA". Required: route_id and county_id are state-specific.
